narrative.intro: Flightsafety Defense obligated $665M in FY2026 to date. Flightsafety Defense received 6 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $111M. Flightsafety Defense obligations are up 778.1% year over year. Flightsafety Defense obligations by fiscal year show a steep jump from prior years: FY21 was $78.9M, FY22 was $74.2M, FY23 was $99.7M, FY24 was $81.3M, and FY25 was $75.7M. Flightsafety Defense work in FY2026 to date concentrates in two NAICS markets: Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing at $641M, and Flight Training at $23.8M. Flightsafety Defense totals reported here are contract obligations, while some tables referenced elsewhere list award-value figures as total contract values. Flightsafety Defense current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. These figures show Flightsafety Defense moved from modest annual obligations in prior years to a much larger obligation level in the current fiscal year.
